findings.what_it_does: Pre-ready check of wave spec, dispatch, and ready payloads against claims.md. Checks CLAIMS_NONEMPTY, CONTEXT_DIGEST, DIGEST_STRAY, CONTEXT_SPEC_EQ, NAMES, BODY_RENDER, READY_DISPATCH, READY_IDENT.
findings.reason: Chousa checks dispatch orchestration and prompt rendering consistency; Kaidoku checks internal claim-object string references to script paths and container pin bindings.

findings.what_it_does: Pre-dispatch freeze checklist parsing Markdown preregistration files (## C<digits> syntax). Checks git blob existence for counters/populations, base ancestry (merge-base --is-ancestor), and wave dispatch timing.
findings.reason: Different input grammar (Markdown preregistration vs JSON claim container) and different validation focus (git commit ancestry and dispatch timing vs claim string path extraction and pin verification).

findings.what_it_does: Replays counter_cmd from kasegi-round-claims-v2 at the base tree. Checks expect_before equals output, expect_after does not occur, and base tree is unmutated.
findings.reason: Dynamic execution replay of counter commands against the base tree, whereas Kaidoku's instrument is a static claim metadata and container pin consistency verifier.

findings.what_it_does: Extracts base revision into scratch, executes declared counting commands from plans/round-N.controls.tsv, and compares measured stdout integers against declared expect values.
findings.reason: Replays numerical counters on extracted base archives; does not inspect claim containers, JSON metadata, or script path pins.

findings.what_it_does: Evaluates mori-freeze-register-v1 to verify that declared frozen inputs predate implementation commits across git rev-list base..tip.
findings.reason: Validates git commit history precedence between frozen files and implementation files; does not inspect claim strings or container pins.

findings.what_it_does: Re-runs claim ledger observation pairs via git cat-file against immutable 40-hex commits to detect recorded-observation drift and vacuity.
findings.reason: Post-hoc observation verification for claim ledgers, not a prefreeze container validation gate.

findings.what_it_does: Batched, cache-backed git-cat-file runner for coldread ledger checks to avoid process spawn overhead.
findings.reason: Execution optimization for historical ledger audits, not a prefreeze claim metadata gate.

findings.what_it_does: Requires survivor mutants to be killed by isolated fixtures that flip a single conjunct.
findings.reason: Tests external tools via isolated test fixtures, rather than scoring single-edit mutant tables against the target tool's own --selftest case failure inventory.

findings.what_it_does: Checks kill direction (rc-silence vs rc-mirror) and enforces mutant population floors.
findings.reason: Validates kill direction categories on gate mutants, but does not bind kills to declared selftest case names.

findings.what_it_does: Validates that selftest arms added for named surviving mutants fail on those mutants.
findings.reason: Evaluates arm counts and tallies without the structured mutants.json anchor/replace table or declared-case failure matching.

findings.what_it_does: Mutates gate scripts and scores kills based on non-zero exit codes and lines starting with FAIL.
findings.reason: Scores whole-suite exit status and generic FAIL lines; does not attribute kills to specific declared case names inside selftest.

findings.what_it_does: Custom regex/AST statement mutation scripts that modify statements and check whether census/audit scripts report discrepancies.
findings.reason: Bespoke statement mutation harness; does not use declared-case attribution or restore-verification mechanics.

findings.what_it_does: Audits SCORECARD.md newest outside closure pointer against dated verifier-spotcheck files.
findings.reason: Homonym hit on 'closure': this is verifier-spotcheck file dating, completely unrelated to mutation testing.

findings.what_it_does: Records observations of REA 6.5.0 on a 2048-byte synthetic firmware image. Explicitly logs in U1, U2, U3 that squashfs was not tested, extractions was empty ({}), and scan depth inside member bytes was unknown.
findings.reason: Revenger documents the absence of SquashFS and nested extraction testing; Kaidoku provides the active reproducible multi-level SquashFS chain measurement.

findings.what_it_does: Mentions unblob as an underlying engine dependency for REA in documentation.
findings.reason: Pure documentation reference; no firmware extraction, SquashFS testing, or measurement tools.

stricter_mechanisms: Git ancestry: verifies git merge-base --is-ancestor <base> <freeze> to prevent detached-base claims
Wave timing: flags DISPATCH-BEFORE-FREEZE if wave artifacts are committed at or before freeze commit
Filesystem hygiene: refuses symlinks (COUNTER-SYMLINK, POPULATION-SYMLINK, CONTROL-SYMLINK)
Claim block grammar: refuses duplicate keys (KEY-DUPLICATE) and non-numeric round numbers (ROUND-MALFORMED)
Commit sequence ordering: validates via git diff-tree across base..tip that frozen claim inputs predate implementation commits
JSON parser strictness: rejects duplicate object keys and non-standard number representations
Plumbing isolation: re-executes observations using pure git cat-file without invoking bash or shell commands
Revision pinning: requires immutable 40-hex commit hashes, rejecting branch/HEAD/tag references
Two-sided validation: checks both observation drift and vacuity (stated_token == observed_token)
Mechanical claim execution: executes every claim command under timeout, requiring exact exit code and regex match on last non-empty line
Stamp file protection: corpus/stamps.tsv requires explicit --prune flag to prevent accidental loss of tracked artifacts
Cross-artifact digest embedding: verifies claims.md SHA-256 is present in dispatch context
Prompt digest hygiene: flags any stray 64-hex SHA-256 tokens (DIGEST_STRAY) to prevent cross-wave context leakage
